{{Quote|Eventually the odds caught up with him, and a Hapani royal assassin punctured his lungs.|Eckard Lokin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Hapani royal assassin''' was in the service of the [[Hapan Royal House]] during the career of [[Cipher Twelve]], an operative of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. The [[Hapan]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Cipher Twelve by puncturing his [[Lung/Legends|lungs]].
